en: Fixed a session on a named Anthropic profile moving to another sign-in when `/fork`, the Left arrow or `--bg` continued it in the background; reopen any session that was open during the update
zh: 修复了使用命名 Anthropic 配置文件的 session 在 `/fork`、左箭头或 `--bg` 于后台继续时切换到其他登录方式的问题；请重新打开更新期间处于打开状态的任何 session
